name: LPC (Legal Practice Course) — BPP, historical (personal interest, no longer required for qualification)
material_vintage: BPP Legal Practice Course Programme Handbook 2017-18 (openly hosted PDF), cross-referenced against the SRA's live LPC route overview and LPC Information Pack (sra.org.uk) for outcomes and requirements, itemised 2026-09-22. BPP no longer runs the LPC live (superseded by the SQE), so the 2017-18 handbook is the most recent fully-resolvable real snapshot of module list, credit values, assessment formats and the Distinction/Commendation/Pass classification scheme, combined with the still-current SRA outcomes framework and competence standard. Practical/procedural content within each module (the actual steps, forms, procedure and professional conduct rules, not just the underlying doctrine) is itemised from the standard LPC/SRA-outcomes topic breakdown for that practice area, as taught on any equivalent legal-practice course of the period, and cites real English statutes, rules and procedure (Companies Act 2006, CPR, PACE 1984, Wills Act 1837, SRA Principles/Code of Conduct, etc.) throughout. Practical Legal Research and Legal Writing are examined as ONE combined module in BPP's real handbook (a single takeaway assessment); this course's stage ladder, inherited unchanged from the prior build, splits them into two stages for teaching granularity, disclosed honestly here rather than inventing two independent BPP assessments.
level_source: RQF/FHEQ Level 7 (Postgraduate Diploma), per QAA Framework for Higher Education Qualifications — the LPC is validated as a postgraduate diploma-level professional legal qualification
